## Pipeline Velocity Bottleneck Detection v1.2
Schedule: Fridays 8 AM (Europe/Berlin)
Output: Slack digest
- Query HubSpot → Get all deals (Return All)
- Calculate → Days-in-stage for each deal
- Classify → HIGH/MEDIUM/OK risk vs. SLA
- Quantify → Tiered revenue at risk (40% / 15% / 0%)
- Stage bottleneck analysis (slowest/fastest stages)
- Week-over-week trend from Google Sheets history

## Read & Extract Data
Gets all deals from HubSpot every Friday at 8am (Europe/Berlin)

## Calculate & Aggregate Data
- Classifies deals at risk based on SLAs
- Calculates tiered revenue at risk
- Prioritizes top 3 risk deals (tier → revenue at risk → days)
- Calculates trend vs. last week
- Calculates stage stats to identify bottlenecks
- Merges results for Slack digest

## Read & Update Data
Reads trend history after the summary is built; writes one row per week (matched on Week Of)

## Distribute Data
Sends summary to Slack Channel
